feature: ADR-0110 saved binding subtree inspection and postorder cancellation with terminal actor cleanup
abi: Pure Rust bounded binding adjacency/tree inspection and terminal cancellation; no unsafe/FFI/dependencies/ABI change; oracle not rerun.

windows.scope: Shared engine changed; native Windows build and previous validations pending prior approval quota issue.

limitations: Tree inspection is read-only metadata, not native permission, source reservation or OS accepted output evidence.

Subtree cancellation returns owned cleanup recipes and discarded-batch identities; caller must discard ALL corresponding queued work before cleanup/resuming. Arena does not execute platform recovery or extra actions.
TerminalActor contains only Output roots, so existing root-only queue discard is sufficient there; complete multi-stage actor must handle all returned batches.
Live payload records exclude Reserved/Released slots, but empty canceled child batches still need queue reconciliation.
Modifier-to-nonmodifier/variable mappings and future reserved descendants require explicit scope semantics; scope difference propagation and complete stage actor remain unfinished.
Private next-stage graph has depth at most three, <=4096 batches and <=16384 slots; BTreeSet adds metadata allocation and no hard latency/RSS guarantee.
Pure shared tests and existing no-input process checks only; no real keyboard/devices/native duration/driver. UnsupportedActionTiming retained.
